# Computational efficiency (generated by `scripts/build_efficiency_table.py` from the logs in `reports/tables`)

Hardware: laptop CPU, 4 logical cores, 12.8 GB RAM, no GPU (`cpu` field of the logs). All times are wall-clock seconds measured by the scripts. Headline models only: XGBoost S4 (full features) and LSTM L4 (full features); ridge for reference. Direct forecasting: one model per horizon and seed.

## 1. Final refit on the training period (frozen configuration of the test run)

Time for the three seeds together, trees and epochs fixed, no early-stopping evaluation (`refit_seconds` of `test_results.jsonl`).

| horizon | ridge (s) | XGBoost S4 (s) | LSTM L4 (s) | LSTM / XGBoost |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 h | 0.09 | 62 | 522 | 8.4 |
| 6 h | 0.22 | 51 | 242 | 4.8 |
| 24 h | 0.34 | 5 | 35 | 7.4 |
| 48 h | 0.16 | 21 | 77 | 3.8 |

| horizon | XGBoost fit (s) | XGBoost trees | XGBoost peak memory (MB) | XGBoost model (MB) | LSTM fit (s) | LSTM epochs run | LSTM peak memory (MB) | LSTM parameters | LSTM model (KB) |

## 3. Inference latency (validation, after warm-up; median)

| horizon | XGBoost, 4,367 rows in one batch (ms) | LSTM, 1,024 windows in one batch (ms) | XGBoost per row (ms) | LSTM per row (ms) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 h | 94 | 164 | 0.021 | 0.160 |
| 6 h | 69 | 131 | 0.016 | 0.128 |
| 24 h | 16 | 60 | 0.004 | 0.058 |
| 48 h | 24 | 83 | 0.006 | 0.081 |

Batch latency per row is the comparable figure (LSTM 7-16 times higher per row than the stage-2 XGBoost models; against the stage-1 XGBoost models of `reports/validation_summary.md` (S4 inference 23-56 ms per batch) the ratio is 10-22 times; the LSTM figure includes the sliding-window construction). Single-row latencies were measured through different Python interfaces and are dominated by overhead, so they are not tabulated.

## 4. Tuning budget

| search | trials | total time (min) | mean per trial (s) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| XGBoost, stage 2 (4 horizons) | 244 | 43.5 | 10.7 |
| LSTM L1/L2/L4 stage 1 (4 horizons) | 48 | 53.1 | 66.4 |
| LSTM L4 stage 3, widened space with pruning (equal-budget tuning) | 312 | 329.4 | 63.3 |

The 72 h and 168 h extensions (`reports/long_*.md`) did not log per-fit time, memory and inference in a comparable form, so they are not part of this table. Timings depend on this machine and on the thread count (XGBoost 4 threads, PyTorch CPU); only the ratios are meant to transfer.
